analysis.overall: You had a strong 89% time in range and a remarkably stable night, but a late-morning spike followed by heavy correction boluses led to a steep afternoon low.

events.title: Dinner rise & pump battery swap
events.description: Glucose bumped up to 174 mg/dL around dinner and a pump battery change, but gentle corrections brought you right back to target by late evening.

events.title: Steady overnight baseline
events.description: Your levels stayed exceptionally smooth between 70 and 110 mg/dL all night, giving you a safe and rested start to the morning.

events.title: Late morning spike
events.description: Glucose shot up quickly to 307 mg/dL, prompting multiple close-together correction boluses to bring it back down.

events.title: Post-correction drop to 54 mg/dL
events.description: The accumulated insulin from earlier corrections combined with your lunch bolus pulled levels down rapidly into a low.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Be mindful of stacking multiple correction boluses during high spikes to avoid a steep drop once all the insulin peaks together.
